SELECT V.V_IDX AS v_idx, V.V_NO AS v_no, V.V_TYPE AS v_type, V.V_MODEL AS v_model, V.V_YEAR AS v_year, V.V_VIN AS v_vin, V.V_FUELTYPE AS v_fueltype, V.V_REGDATE AS v_regdate, V.V_INSP AS v_insp, V.V_INS AS v_ins, V.V_MEMO AS v_memo, (SELECT MAX(VF_DATE) FROM VEHICLE_FUEL WHERE V_IDX = V.V_IDX) AS last_fuel_date, (SELECT TOP 1 VR_DATE FROM VEHICLE_REPAIR WHERE V_IDX = V.V_IDX ORDER BY VR_DATE DESC) AS last_repair_date, (SELECT TOP 1 VR_ITEM FROM VEHICLE_REPAIR WHERE V_IDX = V.V_IDX ORDER BY VR_DATE DESC) AS last_repair_item FROM VEHICLE V WITH(NOLOCK)
AND (V.V_NO LIKE '%'+#{keyword}+'%' OR V.V_MODEL LIKE '%'+#{keyword}+'%')
ORDER BY V.V_TYPE, V.V_NO
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO VEHICLE (V_NO, V_TYPE, V_MODEL, V_YEAR, V_VIN, V_FUELTYPE, V_REGDATE, V_INSP, V_INS, V_MEMO) VALUES (#{v_no}, #{v_type}, #{v_model}, #{v_year}, #{v_vin}, #{v_fueltype}, #{v_regdate}, #{v_insp}, #{v_ins}, #{v_memo})
mapper.select:
SELECT R.VR_IDX AS vr_idx, R.V_IDX AS v_idx, R.VR_DATE AS vr_date, R.VR_ITEM AS vr_item, R.VR_SHOP AS vr_shop, R.VR_COST AS vr_cost, R.VR_ODO AS vr_odo, R.VR_MEMO AS vr_memo, V.V_NO AS v_no, V.V_TYPE AS v_type FROM VEHICLE_REPAIR R WITH(NOLOCK) LEFT JOIN VEHICLE V WITH(NOLOCK) ON V.V_IDX = R.V_IDX
AND R.V_IDX = #{v_idx} AND R.VR_DATE >= #{fromMonth}+'-01' AND R.VR_DATE < DATEADD(MONTH,1,#{toMonth}+'-01')
AND (V.V_NO LIKE '%'+#{keyword}+'%' OR R.VR_ITEM LIKE '%'+#{keyword}+'%' OR R.VR_SHOP LIKE '%'+#{keyword}+'%' OR R.VR_MEMO LIKE '%'+#{keyword}+'%')
ORDER BY R.VR_DATE DESC, R.VR_IDX DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO VEHICLE_REPAIR (V_IDX, VR_DATE, VR_ITEM, VR_SHOP, VR_COST, VR_ODO, VR_MEMO) VALUES (#{v_idx}, #{vr_date}, #{vr_item}, #{vr_shop}, #{vr_cost,jdbcType=DOUBLE}, #{vr_odo,jdbcType=DOUBLE}, #{vr_memo})

WITH ORDERED AS ( SELECT F.*, LAG(F.VF_DATE) OVER (PARTITION BY F.V_IDX ORDER BY F.VF_DATE, F.VF_IDX) AS PREV_DATE FROM VEHICLE_FUEL F WITH(NOLOCK) ) SELECT O.VF_IDX AS vf_idx, O.V_IDX AS v_idx, O.VF_DATE AS vf_date, O.VF_LITER AS vf_liter, O.VF_COST AS vf_cost, O.VF_CARD AS vf_card, O.VF_ODO AS vf_odo, O.VF_STATION AS vf_station, O.VF_MEMO AS vf_memo, V.V_NO AS v_no, V.V_TYPE AS v_type, CASE WHEN O.PREV_DATE IS NOT NULL THEN DATEDIFF(DAY, O.PREV_DATE, O.VF_DATE) ELSE NULL END AS gap_days FROM ORDERED O LEFT JOIN VEHICLE V WITH(NOLOCK) ON V.V_IDX = O.V_IDX
AND O.V_IDX = #{v_idx} AND O.VF_CARD = #{card} AND O.VF_DATE >= #{fromMonth}+'-01' AND O.VF_DATE < DATEADD(MONTH,1,#{toMonth}+'-01')
AND (V.V_NO LIKE '%'+#{keyword}+'%' OR O.VF_STATION LIKE '%'+#{keyword}+'%' OR O.VF_MEMO LIKE '%'+#{keyword}+'%' OR O.VF_CARD LIKE '%'+#{keyword}+'%')
ORDER BY O.VF_DATE DESC, O.VF_IDX DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO VEHICLE_FUEL (V_IDX, VF_DATE, VF_LITER, VF_COST, VF_CARD, VF_ODO, VF_STATION, VF_MEMO) VALUES (#{v_idx}, #{vf_date}, #{vf_liter,jdbcType=DOUBLE}, #{vf_cost,jdbcType=DOUBLE}, #{vf_card}, #{vf_odo,jdbcType=DOUBLE}, #{vf_station}, #{vf_memo})
